en.headline: No lead poisoning cases found after infant formula scare
en.dek: The Department of Health said 237 children who drank a flagged Friso batch have undergone clinical assessment and none showed signs of lead poisoning; a special hotline will close on Friday.
body: The Department of Health confirmed on Wednesday that no cases of lead poisoning have been detected among infants and young children who consumed a batch of Frisolac Prestige Stage 1 infant formula previously flagged by Macau authorities.

As of noon, the department’s dedicated hotline and Maternal and Child Health Centres had received 762 enquiries. Health officers referred 446 babies and young children to the Hospital Authority for assessment; of the 237 who completed clinical checks, all were reported to be in good overall health with no signs of lead poisoning.

The Centre for Food Safety said stepped-up market surveillance of infant formula for lead content has so far found no samples exceeding Hong Kong’s statutory standard. The special hotline will cease operation at 6 p.m. on Friday.

zh.headline: 美素力奶粉事件未發現鉛中毒個案 熱線周五停止
zh.dek: 衞生署表示237名嬰幼兒完成臨床評估，整體健康良好，未有鉛中毒；特別熱線將於周五下午6時起停止運作。
body: 衞生署周三表示，自接獲食安中心通報有關「皇家美素力1號嬰兒配方奶粉」一個批次可能鉛含量超出澳門標準以來，密切跟進曾飲用相關產品的嬰幼兒健康狀況，至今未發現有嬰幼兒出現鉛中毒。
截至中午，衞生署電話熱線及母嬰健康院共接獲762個查詢，並轉介446名嬰幼兒至醫管局接受檢查及跟進。其中237名已完成臨床評估，結果顯示整體健康情況良好，未有鉛中毒。
食安中心加強市面抽檢嬰幼兒配方奶粉鉛含量，至今未有樣本超出本港法定標準。因近期查詢量減少，特別熱線將於周五下午6時起停止運作。
